After the verb क्री 'to purchase', when preceded by परि , वि or अव , the आत्मनेपद affix is employed, even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb मृष् 'to bear', preceded by परि , परस्मैपद is used when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

Terms: परस्मैपद

In the case of the verb पराजि 'to be tired or weary of', that which becomes unbearable, is called अपादान कारक।

Terms: कारक-अपादान

In the case of hiring on wages, that which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action of the verb परिक्री 'employing on stipulated wages', is optionally called सम्प्रदान or receipient.

Terms: कारक-करण

The closest proximity of letters, there being the intervention of half a मात्रा or prosodial length between them, is called contact or संहिता।

Terms:

The words पार 'across' and मध्य 'middle' may optionally be compounded with a word ending in the 6th-Case-affix, when they take forms परे and मध्ये and the compound so formed is अव्ययीभाव।

Terms: समास-अव्ययीभाव

The gender of द्वन्द compound or तत्-पुरुष compound is like that of the last word in it.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द-gender

And subsequent.

Terms: अधिकार

The affix खश् comes after the verb पच् 'to cook' when the object in composition with it denotes a measure.

Terms: खश्

The affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) comes after the verb in the sense of the past before the commencement of the current dayand unperceived by the narrator.

Terms: लिट्

The affix घञ् comes after all roots when the word so formed is the name of a measure.

Terms: घञ्

The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. नी 'to lead' 2. इ 'to go' when the prepositions परि and नि respectively in composition with them and when the words so formed respectively mean 'a game' and 'propriety or arrangement or law'.

Terms: घञ्

The affix घञ् comes after the root इ 'to go' in composition with the word परि when the sense is that of following in regular succession.

Terms: घञ्

The affix घञ् comes after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' in composition with परि when it relates to sacrificial subjects.

Terms: घञ्

The affix घञ् is optionally used after the verb भू 'to be', the word परि being in construction and the sense of the word so formed being 'disregard'.

Terms: घञ्

The affix क also comes after a root हन् 'to kill' when the उपसर्ग परि is in composition and the relation between the word so formed and the verb is that of an instrument and घ replaces हन् ।

Terms: क

The affix ण्वुच् comes optionally after a root in the sense of succession, merit, debt or production.

Terms: ण्वुच्

Optionally so, when a declaration is made with regard to that side of a limit of time.

Terms: II Future

The affix क्त्वा is added to a root, to denote what is situated on the side - पर or on this side of something - अवर।

Terms: क्त्वा

The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a word in the Accusative -2nd case denoting a limb of one's own body, which is completely afflicted by the action, is in composition.

Terms: णमुल्

The affix तुमुन् comes after a verb haivng in composition with it अलम् and its synonyms when these words express to be capable of something.

Terms: तुमुन्

In the room of the परस्मैपद affixes, the following are substituted in the लिट् (Perfect Tense). Singular - णल् (अ), थल् (थ), णल् (अ). Dual - अतुस् (अतुः), अथुस् (अथुः), व (व). Plural - उस् (उः) , अ (अ), म (म).

Terms: लिट्

The affix अण् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'surrounded' the thing so surrounded being 'a chariot'.

Terms: अण्

The affix छ comes after the word पर्वत in the remaining senses.

Terms: छ

The affix यत् comes in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध when preceded by 1. पर 2. अवर 3. अधम and 4. उत्तम।

Terms: यत्

The affix णिनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words 1. पाराशर्य and 2. शिलालिन् , the works enounced being भिक्षु-sūtra and नट-sūtra respectively.

Terms: णिनि

The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'he goes on, by means thereof' after the words पर्प etc.

Terms: ष्ठन्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'it exists' after the word परिमुख being it the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठक् also comes in the sense of 'who stays' after the word परिपन्थ , the word being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ण्य comes after the word परिषद in the sense of 'who assembles there'.

Terms: ण्य

The affix ण्य comes in the sense of 'excellent with regard thereto' after the word परिषद।

Terms: ण्य

The affixes ठञ् and ठक् come in the sense of 'this is whose weapon' after the word परश्वध।

Terms: ठञ् and ठक्

The affix ढञ् (+/- एय) comes after the word परिखा in the above senses of 'this is sufficient for that' and 'this is sufficient therein'.

Terms:
The affix ठञ् (+/- -- इक , प्राग्वतेष्ठञ्

) comes in the sense of 'who performs this' after the words 1. पारायण 2. तुरायण and 3. चान्द्रायण being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix ख (ईन) comes in the sense of 'who witnesses or experiences that' after the words 1. परोवर 2. परम्पर and 3. पुत्रपौत्र , in the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: ख (ईन)

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'who strives to gain something by that' after the word पार्श्व in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: कन्

The affix तसिल् (तस्) comes after परि and अभि also.

Terms: तसिल्

The affix अण् comes after पर्शु etc. and the affix अञ् comes after यौधेय etc. without changing the sense when these words denote warrior classes.

Terms: अण्

The words पारस्कर etc. are Names.

Terms: word meaning

The particles 1. परि 2. प्रति 3. उप and 4. अप preserve their accent before that word which specifies an exclusion or a portion of day and night (in an अव्ययीभाव समास also).

Terms: द्विगु and अव्ययीभाव समास

After परि a word which expresses something which has both this side and that side, as well as the word मण्डल has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

Terms:

The first syllable of the second member is diversely acutely accented (उदात्त) in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms:

The Dative -4th Case endings is not elided after पर when the compound is the name of a technical term in grammar.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

After a numeral, the first vowel of a word denoting mass in its widest sense (with the exception of शाण) gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् when the word so formed does not mean a Name.

Terms: वृद्धि

The word परि is repeated when used in the sense of 'with the exception or exclusion of''.

Terms: Doubling of Words

The र् of परि is changed to ल् before घ and अङ्क।

Terms: र् changed to ल्

ष् is substituted for the स् of 1. सेव् 2. सित 3. सय 4. सिव् 5. सह 6. the augment सुट् 7. स्तु and 8. स्वज् after the उपसर्ग (Prepositions) परि , नि and वि।

Terms: षत्व change

ष् is optionally the substitute of the स् of स्कन्द् after the उपसर्ग (Preposition) परि everywhere.

Terms: षत्व change

The word परिस्कन्द is used without the cerebral change in the country of Eastern Bharata.

Terms: cerebral change
